notes: The manual is pictures only and several steps are ambiguous, so the exact stacking of the chassis plates (b1-b4) and arm layers (b9-b18) is my best reading of the pictures.
Port choices are approximate. I used one representative edge per piece pair. The catalogue's hinge plate lists only 2 studs and 2 anti-studs, so several arm pieces share a port name.
I read the gray 6019 clips (b5, b6) as the front mount that the loader blade assembly (b38 + b39) clips onto in step 8.
I read the arm's rear black clip (b17) as clipping onto the handle of b7 in step 6.

Wheels are attached to the wheel holders of the 4600 plates. The big wheels (b30, b31) are on the rear plate b3. The small wheels (b34, b35) are on the front plate b1. Tyres are pressed onto their wheels.
Step 8 is not a repeated sub-assembly, so there are no repeats.
